svg.title: Text-only order management terminal
svg.desc: A retro terminal window displaying a Zork-inspired order management session ending with a grue.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
g.text: You are standing in a pitch-black system lobby.
You feel a light flurry of snow.
You have been eaten by a grue.
